introHtml: Zoom-certified mobile devices ensure your team experiences reliable video calls and screen sharing without compatibility issues. Whether you're equipping a remote sales force or kitting out a conference room, branded Zoom mobile devices combine hardware optimization with your logo. Choose from tablets and smartphones preloaded with Zoom, or add custom skins and cases that keep your brand visible on every call.
